integrity: Proof is self-contained modulo explicitly cited classical suspension and cycle homotopy theorems. Finite executable checks corroborate but do not substitute for the proof. No independent mathematical audit has occurred.
scientific_limitations: The formulas concern the canonical dihedral action on ordinary Mycielskian cycle independence complexes and rational quotient homology, not integral equivariant lattices, integral quotient torsion, or higher generalized-Mycielski levels. The underlying ordinary homotopy type is prior work. Orders n=3 and n=6 have previously determined symmetry data from more specific constructions. Unindexed equivalent publications remain a priority risk.
title: Complete dihedral rational homology character of ordinary cycle Mycielski independence complexes
